site.title: Ledgerline Payroll | Payroll and bookkeeping teams for UK firms
site.description: Ledgerline Payroll runs payroll and bookkeeping teams for UK accounting practices and small businesses.

data.title: Payroll and bookkeeping teams for *UK accounting firms*
data.lead: Ledgerline Payroll runs monthly payroll, pension submissions and bookkeeping for UK practices, with one account manager for every client.

cards.title: Monthly payroll
cards.text: Payslips, starters and leavers, statutory pay and RTI submissions run on your payroll software and checked before release.

cards.title: Bookkeeping
cards.text: Bank reconciliations, purchase and sales ledgers and month-end journals prepared for your review.

cards.title: Pension submissions
cards.text: Auto-enrolment assessments and pension contribution files sent to each provider on schedule.

cards.title: Reporting
cards.text: A monthly pack with payroll totals, variances and open queries, reviewed with your account manager.

head.title: How it works
head.lead: Most practices hand over their first payroll run within a month of the first call.

steps.title: Review your payroll
steps.text: We look at your employee count, pay dates, pension schemes and the software you use.

steps.title: Set up access
steps.text: Your account manager sets up access to your payroll and bookkeeping software and agrees a monthly timetable.

steps.title: Run and report
steps.text: We run each payroll, send the reports for your approval and file the submissions after you sign off.

aside.title: Have a question about your payroll?
aside.text: An account manager can walk you through how a monthly run works with your software.

items.q: Which payroll software do you work in?
items.a: We work in the payroll software you already use, so your employees and records stay where they are.
You do. We send the reports before every run and only release payslips after you sign off.

items.q: Can you take over part way through the tax year?
items.a: Yes. We take the year-to-date figures from your current records and continue from the next pay date.

items.q: Who is our contact at Ledgerline?
items.a: Every client has one account manager who handles the timetable, queries and the monthly report.
